interface.title: InfoClus | A Dashboard for explainable clustering helping you understand your dataset better
interface.field: Exploratory data analysis / explainable clustering (examples from flow cytometry and socio-economic statistics)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory analysis and interpretation of high-dimensional tabular data
interface.what_it_is_for: Cluster a tabular dataset on its 2D embedding, then see which attributes explain each cluster or any region you select, shown as per-attribute KDE curves ranked by an information score.

data.note: Used the bundled cytometry_2500 dataset (2500 rows × 9 markers, with tsne/pca/pacmap_emb/vivae_emb embeddings) and german_socio_eco (412 rows × 31 indicators). I chose ImmuneW_HDdata, but it was still computing ('Updating...') after about 13 screenshots. No test files were available for upload. One PNG of the scatter plot was downloaded (newplot.png).

tree.general: Find groups in high-dimensional data and understand which variables make each group distinct
tree.specific: Run InfoClus on a bundled dataset, look at its clusters on a 2D embedding, and read the KDE explanations for each cluster and for selected regions

children.general: See which variables distinguish a chosen cluster, ranked by explanatory strength
children.specific: Pick a cluster in the 'Explanation for CLUSTER n' menu. The right panel shows one KDE plot per explaining attribute: the solid blue line is the whole data, the dotted line in the cluster's colour is the cluster's own distribution, and the filled area is the cluster's density scaled by its share of the data ('% Overlapped by Cluster'), i.e. how much of the data at each value the cluster covers. Plots are titled with the attribute's IC score (e.g. CD3-IC-1192.9) and ordered by it.

children.general: Tune the clustering and see how groups and explanations change
children.specific: Set alpha, beta, min_att, max_att, the sidebar Embedding the clustering is computed on, and Recalc runtime; InfoClus re-runs

children.general: Change the clustering parameters and recompute
children.specific: Lowering alpha (250→53) and re-running cut Cluster 0's explanation from 4 to 2 attributes. A second run (alpha 97, beta 1.9, Recalc runtime 10 s) merged the 3 clusters into 2. After each run the alpha range was rescaled; after the second, min_att/max_att went back to 2/5 and the runtime to 1 s. The sidebar Embedding dropdown chooses which embedding the clustering is computed on at the next recalculation; it was set to pacmap_emb but no run followed.

features.name: Cluster explanation panel with ranked per-attribute density plots
features.general: Pick a group from a list and see a stack of small density plots, one per variable that best tells this group apart, comparing the group's distribution with the whole data's
features.specific: Choose 'Explanation for CLUSTER n'; hover it to see the cluster's share of data; read the stacked KDE plots titled attribute-IC-score (solid blue = whole data, dotted in the cluster colour = the cluster's distribution, filled = the cluster's density scaled by its share of the data, '% Overlapped by Cluster'); scroll for more attributes
steps: open the cluster menu and pick a cluster
hover the menu to read the cluster's share of the data
read the KDE plot for each explaining attribute, ordered by IC score
scroll the panel to see the rest of the attributes
serves_tasks: See which variables distinguish a chosen cluster, ranked by explanatory strength

features.name: Hyper-parameter tuning with timed re-run
features.general: Adjust the clustering's granularity, how many variables may explain each group and which 2D embedding the clustering runs on, then re-run with a chosen time budget and compare
features.specific: Set alpha (range rescales per dataset), beta, min_att, max_att and the sidebar Embedding the clustering is computed on, then pick 'recalculate in 1/10/30/60 s'; 'Updating...' runs, then the scatter and explanation panels refresh
steps: drag the alpha and beta sliders
type min_att and max_att
choose in the sidebar Embedding dropdown which embedding to cluster on
choose a Recalc runtime to start the run
compare the new clusters and their explanations
serves_tasks: Change the clustering parameters and recompute
